title: New fluent tracking functions must be exported in both mlflow/__init__.py import list and __all__
answers: how do I expose a new function as mlflow.something at top level
mlflow.restore_run not found after adding it to fluent.py
where do fluent API functions get registered for the mlflow namespace
add a top-level convenience function to the mlflow package
body:
Invariant: a public fluent function defined in mlflow/tracking/fluent.py is reachable as mlflow.<name> only if it is listed in the import block of mlflow/__init__.py and in its __all__ list.
The two lists must be edited together; the PR added restore_experiment and restore_run to both, placed next to their delete_* siblings.
Enforced by: mlflow/__init__.py:__all__ and the 'from mlflow.tracking.fluent import (...)' block.
If skipped: the function exists in fluent.py but is missing from the top-level namespace and from the public API listing.
The API inventory docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt lists these names too; the PR description calls it auto-generated and says it needs regeneration (/autoformat), so prefer regenerating over hand-editing.
applies: Any new public function added to mlflow/tracking/fluent.py that should be callable as mlflow.<name>.
says: The command to restore a deleted run is missing from the main tracking package.
Provide a top-level convenience method to restore experiments alongside existing deletion commands.
Users cannot find the action to restore runs in the public tracking interface.
Make run restoration available as a primary command in the tracking client.
The public library reference omits commands for restoring experiments and deleted runs.
search: Public fluent tracking functions added to mlflow/tracking/fluent.py must be exported in both the mlflow/__init__.py import block and its __all__ list to be reachable in the top-level mlflow namespace. This applies to functions such as restore_experiment and restore_run placed alongside delete siblings. Omitting either export leaves the function missing from the top-level namespace and public API listings. The auto-generated API inventory docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt must also include these names via /autoformat regeneration rather than hand-editing.
